<!-- Reference: 'Dinosaurs' television series-->
Triceratops men have a distaste towards other [[Animal_person#Extinct_animal_people|extinct animal men]] slacking off, yet find the concept of extinct animal ''women'' having jobs ludicrous. They are short-tempered and often yell at their co-workers, especially [[Tyrannosaurus_man|tyrannosaurus men]]. Some dwarves theorize that their infamously short tempers are linked to their tendency to direct other extinct animal men in [[woodcutting]] operations, since it may be that the triceratops men are unwittingly [[Creature#Agitation|agitating]] themselves ever further by ordering the destruction of so many trees in the untamed wilds they typically inhabit.
